records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Silver Dynamics!
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Admin explicitly said she's been heads-down elsewhere and hasn't dug in [email:10c98e47]; day 6 with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and no tickets (zero product engagement). 8 days left, Pro plan and an engaged reply give some chance, but no stated intent or timeline.

draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Silver Dynamics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the honest reply — totally understandable that Wrenfield hasn't been top of the list while you're heads-down elsewhere.

When you do get a window, the first step is a small one: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. Whenever you're bringing others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you so it's done and off your plate.

Best,
Priya
